visualCharacteristics.purpose: image column beside a text column (eyebrow, heading, text, checklist, buttons)

contentPattern.structure: one row per media pair: image cell + text cell (either order). Text cell: eyebrow, heading, text, optional list with leading icons, buttons. A cell holding only a /fragments/ link is replaced by the fragment. faq: text-only columns split by rules. icon-feature-list: icon + heading + text items. centred-image: text | image | text. dark on text-only: heading | copy split by a rule

usage: Promotional image + text sections, checklists beside photos, CD basics icon lists, app feature callouts
reuseGuidance: Use for image + text pairs and text-column splits. Not for contact panels (columns-contact).
